bench_e2e.title: End-to-end SQL bioseq.load + mmsearch vs minimap2 (2/4 Gbp dna4/dna5)
bench_e2e.description: End-to-end SQL-driven 2/4 Gbp benchmark. bioseq via bioseq.load + SELECT mmsearch; minimap2 via CLI on the split FASTA. no_index = from-scratch build+map counted; just_index = index prebuilt untimed, then measured COLD after a PostgreSQL restart (both bioseq variants restart per just_index cell). All bioseq paths run in TASK_PARALLEL. Two aligner frontends: block_simd_dp_two_stack_nthash (block aligner + SIMD-mm2 chaining + two-stack nthash minimizer) and gpu_dp_gpu_seed (DOC0310 Phase C Vulkan GPU seeding + tiled-DP chaining). Each bioseq path is swept over per-fragment and per-sequence minimizer indexes.
